feature: Phase 7 of spike-research-agents: Synthesis — ACAM matrix, rules-skills scorecard, red-team pass, publication deliverables (acam-worksheet.md, spike-research-agents.md, blog outline, scorecard.json)
problem: Phases 1-6 produced four independently-verified dimension analyses (Configuration, Workflows, Multi-agent, Interaction) all scoring Intermediate. Phase 7 must synthesize these into a self-contained research output that: (1) makes the Intermediate+top-1% duality legible via a two-axis scorecard, not a flat verdict; (2) attempts a genuine Basic case on ≥1 dimension and either sustains or rebuts it; (3) produces three publication-ready deliverables each independently usable.
proposed_solution: Three deliverables: (A) acam-worksheet.md — standalone 4×3 scoring tool ≤60 lines; (B) spike-research-agents.md — master synthesis 1,500-3,000 words including two-axis scorecard, red-team pass, and blog series outline; (C) rules-skills-scorecard.json — machine-readable scores with evidence[] and gaps[] per dimension.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: acam-worksheet.md exists at .harness/docs/research/acam-worksheet.md with ≤60 lines; contains a 4×3 grid (4 dimensions × 3 levels) with at least one observable question per cell; includes scoring instructions that do not reference any phase doc

AC2: spike-research-agents.md exists at .harness/docs/research/spike-research-agents.md between 1,500 and 3,000 words; contains no phase-doc-dependent content — the full ACAM score and top findings for each dimension must be stated inline

AC3: spike-research-agents.md contains a two-axis table or section showing BOTH the ACAM level AND the population tier for each of the four dimensions — neither axis is omitted, and neither is presented as canceling the other

AC4: spike-research-agents.md contains a red-team section that attempts a genuine Basic case on the Workflows dimension (33% session boundary + zero skill_activation eval coverage as the argument) and gives an explicit verdict — either the case holds (downgrade to Basic) or it fails (with the specific rebuttal evidence). A section that only concludes 'Intermediate is justified' without engaging the Basic argument fails AC4

AC5: spike-research-agents.md contains a 'What to steal first' section with ≥3 ranked recommendations for a practitioner at Tier 0-1 who wants to move up without building the full harness — each recommendation must be specific (name the file or pattern, not a category)
AC6: spike-research-agents.md contains a blog series outline with 4 posts — each post has a one-sentence thesis and ≥3 evidence points drawn from the bibliography

AC7: rules-skills-scorecard.json exists at .harness/docs/research/rules-skills-scorecard.json; contains entries for all 4 dimensions each with: level (string), population_tier (string), evidence (array of ≥2 file paths), gaps (array of ≥2 strings with severity)

AC8: The BC3 revisions from all four dimension phases are reflected in the ACAM matrix in acam-worksheet.md — specifically: 'acceptance-criteria-gated implementation' for Workflows Advanced, 'trust boundary enforcement' for Multi-agent Advanced, 'structured context delivery' for Interaction Advanced

AC9: spike-research-agents.md §BC-compliance states that BC1 (external sources cited by label), BC3 (ACAM criteria externally validated), and BC6 (no hedging in scores or gap sections) are each pass or fail — scores and gaps in spike-research-agents.md must match the phase doc verdicts
edge_cases: EC1: The red-team section must name the specific evidence that defeats the Basic argument for Workflows — 'the contract gate and traced execution exist' is not sufficient; the rebuttal must explain why a 33% behavioral score does not override the structural evidence, or concede that it does

EC2: acam-worksheet.md must be independently scorable: apply it to a fictional repo with no rules, no hooks, no harness — the scoring instructions must produce 'Basic' on all four dimensions without ambiguity
EC3: The 'What to steal first' recommendations must not all come from the same dimension — at least 3 distinct dimensions must be represented across the ≥3 recommendations
verification_method: Evaluator reads all three deliverables. For AC1, counts lines in acam-worksheet.md. For AC2, counts words in spike-research-agents.md. For AC3, finds the two-axis table. For AC4, reads the red-team section and checks for explicit Basic argument + verdict. For EC1, checks that the rebuttal names specific evidence, not just a category. For EC2, mentally applies acam-worksheet.md to a repo with zero infrastructure — all four dimensions must clearly score Basic.
